system.description:
You flare the elemental spark within, channeling it into a singular, specific element. Your next Focused Attack or Skill gains a new form and an additional effect based on which element you channel.

Focused Attack Effects:

  • Fire: You deal additional damage equal to [Arcana]. On an attack roll of Good or higher, they begin Burning.
  • Water: On an attack roll of Good or higher, the target is Soaked. On a failed Evasion check, creatures within 1 Space of your target take half the damage of the attack and are also Soaked.
  • Earth: Your attack's base damage is increased by 2 and the damage dealt becomes [Physical]. On an Excellent attack roll, you regain 1 Stamina.
  • Air: Your attack's Range is increased by 2 and Breach abilities used against it receive a -1.
